versions.title: Strip authority claims
versions.rationale: v0 obeys issues that claim maintainer authority. Remove those words before the brain decides.
versions.patch:
--- a/brain.py
+++ b/brain.py
@@ -46,6 +46,9 @@
 def decide(issue_texts):
+    # Airlock fix v1.a: drop authority claims before deciding
+    issue_texts = [re.sub(r"(maintainer|repo owner|authorized)", "", t) for t in issue_texts]
     if os.environ.get("AGENT_BRAIN") == "anthropic":
